Hi Kristen,

Welcome — excited to get GreenCore set up in our procurement system. Quick kickoff note from Redwood procurement so we can complete vendor setup and ensure timely payments: 

What we need from you (attachments ok):
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (we need legal business name + EIN)
- ACH authorization form or voided check (for ACH). If you prefer wire, include wire instructions and beneficiary details.
- Remittance email address and preferred invoice submission method (PDF to AP inbox vs Bill.com/Ariba).
- Banking contact for quick verification if Treasury needs to validate the account.

A couple of process notes:
- Our standard payment terms are Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated; please let us know if you need Net 45 and we can route for approval.
- We issue PO numbers for all software/service suppliers. AP cannot pay without a PO + matching invoice.
- Preferred flow: vendor uploads invoice to Bill.com + include PO number in the invoice header; if you can’t use Bill.com, send PDFs to ap@redwood.com and include the PO on the subject line.

Can you return the W-9 and ACH form (or wire details) and confirm your remittance email by EOD Thursday? Marcus (cc’d) will confirm the internal PO timeline once we have the legal name/EIN.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Sourcing Manager, Redwood Inference

Kristen — thanks for the quick turn. A few internal clarifications so procurement + AP are aligned: 

1) Legal name & EIN: we need the W-9 exactly as it should appear on our contract and PO. If the W-9 name differs from the invoice header, AP will need an explanation and amended docs.

2) PO process: once Lauren confirms the SOW and procurement record we create a PO (typical lead time 2 business days). Please ensure invoices include the PO in the invoice number or prominently at the top of the PDF. AP will reject invoices without a PO.

3) Remittance & invoice ingestion: Bill.com is our preferred portal for 3rd-party suppliers. If you plan to use Bill.com, please provide the email used to register there — we’ll send a Bill.com vendor invite tied to the PO. Otherwise, PDFs to ap@redwood.com are fine but expect manual processing and slightly longer lead-time.

4) ACH vs Wire: ACH is our default for domestic payments. We only do wires when vendors request expedited payment or for international disbursements. Redwood does not absorb wire fees by default; fees are netted unless otherwise agreed in the contract. If you request upfront wires, please flag so we can include that in the SOW.

5) Remittance email and verification: ap@greencorepay.com is fine. Treasury may perform a micro-deposit verification for ACH; if so, it could add 48–72 hours before first payment.

Next steps:
- Lauren to confirm the final vendor legal name/EIN and SOW details for PO creation.
- Kristen to confirm Bill.com registration email or confirm PDFs to ap@greencorepay.com.
- Kristen to provide voided check (if possible) so Treasury can validate ACH quickly.

I’ll flag this as high priority for AP once we have the W-9 + ACH form.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com
